scope: Downloaded model payloads in download_weights.sh and the canonical full-API install check; code licenses and model-weight permissions are distinguished.
legal_signoff: NOT_OBTAINED: engineering evidence review, not legal advice or a finding that an unresolved use is unlawful
notice_capture_status: Pinned URLs and SHA-256 of retrieved notice/card bytes recorded below; this is not a complete bundled LICENSE/NOTICE package.

local_evidence.binding_note: The local LICENSE equals the retrieved MuseTalk model-repository LICENSE.txt byte-for-byte. Existing local model files were not inspected or downloaded by this review. Upstream LFS hashes below are reference metadata, not assertions about deployed files.

global_findings: Only TAESD and Kokoro have explicit revision defaults in download_weights.sh. MuseTalk V1.5, SD-VAE, Whisper, DWPose and LatentSync currently download floating repository revisions. The observed commits below must be bound to the exact packaged bytes before release.
TAESD skips download if two local files exist, and Kokoro keeps an existing refs/main. Therefore even their default revision strings do not prove the installed payload's identity.

A permissive code license does not by itself establish permission for externally hosted pretrained weights. Conversely a training dataset restriction is a review flag, not an automatic legal conclusion about every resulting model.
TensorRT plans, converted FP16 weights and quantized derivatives need a recorded chain to the source weights and their notices; compilation does not remove license obligations.
Public download availability is not a redistribution grant. Private registry storage, private object storage or fetch-at-boot does not cure an underlying permission gap.

Do not bake demonstration images/videos, canonical private avatar fixtures or generated evaluation captures: the MuseTalk README separately restricts its internet-sourced test data to noncommercial research.

This review does not clear CUDA/cuDNN/TensorRT, FFmpeg, pip/apt transitive dependencies, voice/personality rights, privacy or the complete final container layers. Their notices and applicable distribution terms remain separate release work.

Include OpenAI MIT notice and applicable Apache-2.0 text/attribution for the converted package; preserve any required NOTICE and identify conversion changes.
Confirm the release owner's attribution decision and exact payload revision/hash.

required_actions: Include the author MIT notice and pinned model card.
If using the already-vendored FP16 copy, record its transformation and hash instead of claiming it equals the FP32 upstream artifact.

The newer LatentSync-1.6 stable_syncnet.pt is a different asset and cannot establish this file's license.
required_actions: Obtain the exact OpenRAIL++ license text/version and explicit applicability to this SyncNet checkpoint, or written clarification from the rights holder.
Review downstream restrictions, required pass-through terms and notices before redistribution; do not replace the model's terms with the GitHub code's Apache license.

The current avatar-prep install check requires this file although searched runtime references were training/quality evaluation. Removal needs a separately tested capability/installer contract change, not deletion to evade the review.

models.weight_license_evidence: The exact Drive ID is linked as the pretrained model in the author's MIT code repository. It is trained on CelebAMask-HQ. Dataset terms restrict commercial exploitation, including derived data, and upstream issue 47 explicitly asks about commercial model-weight redistribution without an answer at review time.
required_actions: Obtain rights-holder clarification and qualified review of the exact pretrained model's commercial use/redistribution and dataset-derived-data terms.
Do not claim the training dataset automatically licenses or prohibits every trained weight; record the unresolved scope.
Hash the exact Drive artifact and retain MIT code notices independently of the model decision.

This model is in SERVER_MODEL_FILES and FaceParsing is instantiated by the avatar manager. Excluding it breaks the current full server contract; do not silently disable face parsing or declare endpoint parity.

models.weight_license_evidence: The official torchvision README explicitly separates pretrained-model terms from its code license and assigns use-case permission checking to users. This review did not locate a weight-specific redistribution grant for this legacy checkpoint.
required_actions: Confirm the legacy checkpoint's applicable model/training-data terms rather than treating torchvision BSD as blanket weight clearance.
Retain torchvision code copyright, BSD terms and disclaimer where applicable; hash the actual weight.

This backbone is checked by the server installer and loaded by BiSeNet initialization. Any claim it can be omitted because a later checkpoint overwrites its parameters requires a separate code/test change and full quality validation.

The face-alignment loader references the same named external adrianbulat.com weight; its BSD code license does not explicitly identify that external checkpoint as covered. Local MuseTalk LICENSE merely lists S3FD as open-source without a license name.
required_actions: Obtain an explicit commercial-use and redistribution grant for the exact s3fd-619a316812 checkpoint and clarify any original implementation/model rights.
Do not treat ByteDance's mirror or the face-alignment BSD code license as proof of authority to relicense the external weights.
Retain duplicate destination hashes in the release inventory; avoid unnecessarily storing two copies only after the loader contract is tested.
Do not remove the detector from the full avatar-prep image or enable network fallback silently. Any cleared replacement needs preparation correctness and visual-quality regression tests.

release_options_not_implemented.requirement: Resolve all HOLD entries and exact-byte provenance, assemble complete notices, then obtain the release owner's redistribution signoff before any public image or model upload.

Only if existing permissions actually cover the intended private use. Keep unresolved assets out of public layers; pre-stage authorized payloads through private authenticated mounts/volumes and verify hashes before readiness. Measure any cold-fetch overhead. Do not claim full API availability until all required models are present.

Do not silently drop avatar preparation, face parsing or local TTS. Current installer requires face-parse/backbone for server and SyncNet/S3FD/DWPose for avatar-prep. Any capability split or legally cleared replacement needs an explicit API contract, installer change and complete correctness/quality tests.

latentsync_model_inventory.finding: No LICENSE or NOTICE sibling; per-weight hashes and sizes retrieved without downloading weights.

face_parsing_license_issue.finding: Open user question, no visible activity/rights-holder answer at review time; not itself a license grant or legal ruling.

s3fd_original_tree.finding: Complete, nontruncated tree contains no path matching LICENSE, NOTICE or COPYING.

metadata_method: Read-only HTTPS GET of upstream model cards, license files, author READMEs and complete GitHub/Hugging Face metadata. SHA-256 values for source text are computed from fetched bytes. Weight references come from the listed model repository's /api/models/{repo}/revision/{revision}?blobs=true LFS metadata. No model download, upload, account change, contact with maintainers or publication performed.
